content.json:
## AgentOS.NET — operations
LLM tokens and cost, runs, budget, evidence and HTTP health. Custom metrics arrive as OpenTelemetry metrics (`customMetrics`, delta sums per export). Member-computer runs (`gen_ai.system = agentos.remote_agent`) report ≈ estimated tokens and cost 0. Runbooks: [docs/OPERATIONS.md](https://github.com/hoangsnowy/AgentOS.NET/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md).

content.query:
requests
| where name !has "/health" and name !has "/alive"
| summarize Total = sum(itemCount), Errors = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500)
| extend Availability = round(100.0 * (1 - todouble(Errors) / iff(Total == 0, 1.0, todouble(Total))), 3)
| project Availability, Total, Errors
content.title: Availability (non-5xx share, SLO 99.5%)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.pipeline.runs"
| extend Outcome = tostring(customDimensions["agentos.run.outcome"])
| summarize Failed = sumif(valueSum, Outcome == "failed"), Started = sumif(valueSum, Outcome in ("done", "max_iterations", "failed"))
| extend Reliability = round(100.0 * (1 - Failed / iff(Started == 0, 1.0, Started)), 2)
| project Reliability, Started, Failed
content.title: Run reliability (SLO 95%)

content.query:
requests
| where name !has "_blazor" and name !has "/hubs/" and name !has "/pipeline" and name !has "/mcp" and name !has "/health" and name !has "/alive"
| summarize P95ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0), P50ms = round(percentile(duration, 50), 0)
content.title: HTTP p95 (SLO 1 s)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.evidence.lost"
| summarize Lost = sum(valueSum)
| extend Lost = coalesce(Lost, 0.0)
content.title: Evidence rows lost (must be 0)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.llm.tokens"
| extend Class = tostring(customDimensions["agentos.token.class"])
| where Class != "reasoning"
| summarize Tokens = sum(valueSum) by Class, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Tokens by billing class

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.llm.cost.usd"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| summarize CostUsd = sum(valueSum) by Agent, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Cost (USD) by agent
Cost, calls and tokens by agent × model

content.query:
dependencies
| where name startswith "chat "
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by Model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.request.model"]), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: LLM call latency p50 / p95 by model (from chat spans)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.llm.errors"
| summarize Errors = sum(valueSum) by ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"]), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Failed LLM attempts by error type

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.pipeline.runs"
| summarize Runs = sum(valueSum) by Outcome = tostring(customDimensions["agentos.run.outcome"]), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Runs by outcome

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("agentos.budget.utilization", "agentos.budget.enforced")
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, valueMax) by Tenant = tostring(customDimensions["agentos.tenant.id"]), name
| summarize UsedPercent = round(100.0 * maxif(valueMax, name == "agentos.budget.utilization"), 1), Enforced = maxif(valueMax, name == "agentos.budget.enforced") == 1, LastEvaluated = max(timestamp) by Tenant
| order by UsedPercent desc
content.title: Budget used by tenant (last evaluation)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.budget.blocked"
| summarize Refusals = sum(valueSum) by Scope = tostring(customDimensions["agentos.budget.scope"]), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Budget refusals

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agentos.health.status"
| summarize Worst = min(valueMin) by Check = tostring(customDimensions["agentos.health.check"]), Role = cloud_RoleName
| extend Status = case(Worst >= 1, "Healthy", Worst >= 0.5, "Degraded", "Unhealthy")
| project Role, Check, Status
content.title: Health checks (worst status)

content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests = sum(itemCount) by Class = strcat(substring(resultCode, 0, 1), "xx"), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Requests by result code class

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("signalr.server.active_connections", "aspnetcore.components.circuit.active", "aspnetcore.components.circuit.connected")
| summarize Value = max(valueMax) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: SignalR connections and Blazor circuits
